{{Otheruses|Stargazer}}
The '''Stargazer Grill Restaurant''' was a restaurant located on Level F on one of the wings of [[Spaceport THX1138]]. Its motto was "You can enjoy dishes being surrounded by stars." Meals and drinks included on its menu were [[Agamar slider]]s, [[Tip-yip/Legends|Endorian chicken]], [[Blue milk/Legends|Blue milk]], [[Calamaria Surprise]], [[Nerf steak/Legends|Nerf steak]], [[Roast Galma]], [[Lambro shark]], and [[Berbersian crab]].<ref name="Star Tours">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
